base_prompt:
SPRITE for a comedic browser game, full body, transparent background (real alpha channel), no ground shadow, no glow, no text, no watermark, ONE character only, nothing cropped (head to feet fully visible, feet at the bottom of the canvas). Portrait orientation about 2:3, centered.
ART STYLE: match the attached reference image's rendering style exactly (semi-realistic cel-shaded cartoon, thick dark navy outline, bold saturated colors, soft highlights) BUT DO NOT copy the reference character: the reference is only a style guide (it is a muscular Santa), and the new character must look completely different.
Proportions: cute, slightly chibi/cartoon proportions (large head, short body, about 3 heads tall) unless stated otherwise, so the character is readable at a very small size. Standing front view, facing the viewer. Hands may be raised/clenched but hold nothing unless stated.

jobs.name: kid_good_a_idle
jobs.prompt: A GOOD little kid (about 7 years old), unmistakably sweet and innocent: big sparkling eyes, rosy cheeks, a huge happy smile, round friendly face. Wears a bright blue puffy winter coat, a red knitted beanie with a white pom-pom, a red-and-white striped scarf, brown boots and red mittens. A small glowing golden HALO floats above the head. Both arms raised up and open in joyful expectation, as if waiting for a present. Warm, bright, adorable color palette.

jobs.name: kid_good_b_idle
jobs.prompt: A GOOD little kid (about 7 years old, a different kid from other designs): freckles, big sparkling eyes, rosy cheeks, huge happy smile, short brown pigtail braids sticking out of the hat. Wears a sunny yellow puffy winter coat, a purple knitted beanie with a pom-pom, a green scarf, brown boots and orange mittens. A small glowing golden HALO floats above the head. Both arms raised up and open in joyful expectation, waiting for a present. Warm, bright, adorable color palette.

jobs.name: thug_a_idle
jobs.prompt: A BAD kid, a tough little street hooligan (about 10 years old, child-sized but menacing): scowling face with thick slanted angry eyebrows, glowing red eyes, a scar across the cheek with stitches, small sharp fangs showing in a sneer. Red bandana on the forehead and a spiky red mohawk, a gold chain necklace, a gold earring, a dark purple-black hooded jacket with metal studs, torn grey jeans, black boots. One hand rests a wooden baseball bat studded with nails on the shoulder, the other fist is clenched. Dark, menacing red-purple palette, the opposite of cute.

jobs.name: thug_b_idle
jobs.prompt: A BAD kid, a different tough little street hooligan (about 10 years old, child-sized but menacing): scowling with thick angry eyebrows, glowing red eyes, a missing tooth and a nasty grin with fangs. Black bandana and a spiky ORANGE mohawk, a spiked leather collar, a dark green hooded jacket with studs, torn black jeans, black boots. One hand cracks the knuckles of a clenched fist, the other holds a wooden bat studded with nails resting on the shoulder. Dark, menacing palette, the opposite of cute.

jobs.name: goblin_a_idle
jobs.prompt: A BAD little goblin kid (child-sized): green skin, enormous long pointed ears sticking out sideways, glowing yellow eyes with slit pupils, a big crooked nose, a wide mouth full of jagged teeth in an evil grin, a tuft of black hair. Wears a ragged brown tunic with a torn jagged hem, no shoes. He is hugging a small STOLEN red gift box with a gold ribbon to his chest with a greedy smirk. Dark, mischievous palette.

jobs.name: goblin_b_idle
jobs.prompt: A different BAD little goblin kid (child-sized): sickly yellow-green skin, huge drooping pointed ears with a small hole in one, bulging orange eyes with slit pupils, a warty hooked nose, a crooked sneer with jagged teeth, a few strands of white hair. Wears a ragged dark-blue patched vest and torn shorts, bare feet. He clutches a small STOLEN blue gift box with a silver ribbon under one arm and rubs his hands together greedily. Dark, mischievous palette.

jobs.name: yeti_idle
jobs.prompt: A giant menacing YETI monster (this one is NOT child-sized; very large, bulky, about 2 heads tall with a huge torso): thick white and pale-blue shaggy fur, a blue-grey face mask with deep angry brows, glowing yellow eyes with red pupils, a huge mouth with big white fangs, two icy-blue curved horns on the head, big furry arms hanging at the sides ending in massive fists with sharp blue-grey claws, large furry feet. Standing facing the viewer, intimidating and slightly comical.
